findings.title: Inconsistent function naming in handler module
findings.description: Some functions use camelCase while most of the module uses snake_case.
findings.claude_md_rule: MUST use snake_case for all Python function and variable names.

findings.title: Retry logic does not guard against duplicate side effects
findings.description: The retry wrapper resubmits the request without checking whether the prior attempt already applied its effect.
findings.spec_text: The API contract requires idempotent retries on failure.
